snippet.title: BRAINSHELL - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🪖 Enlist in the Operation: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206220?utm_source=youtube&utm_campagin=announce

Stuck inside a nuclear missile, you are become one with the machine. A being born from flesh and steel, you live to serve one purpose: to fly towards death.

There is no escape from the metal shell that cages you. You are the weapon, and the weapon must be used.

📡 Report to Command on Discord: https://discord.gg/VEkxzXByqU
Bluesky channel broadcast: https://bsky.app/profile/brainshell.bsky.social
Twitter/X channel broadcast: https://x.com/Brainshellgame

Trailer editing by https://joakimjaulimo.com/
Music and audio by https://alihosseini.net/home
